races.drawBiasExplanation: Inside position advantageous around left-handed bends

verdict.comment: The key may well lie with handicap newcomers SHABU SHABU, Grande Armee and Hot Shot Lawyer and market moves should be noted.

comments.abstractart: Ten-race maiden; latest start was first in 127 days; could build on that on return to turf
comments.aureliusmaximus: Easily closest finish latest (1m2f handicap) but needs a good deal better; 5lb claimer now
comments.cudabeenarowlex: Won at Redcar (1m2f, good) in April; well below form on both starts since; cheekpieces now
comments.dancenomore: Best form debut; 40-1 for handicap/turf debut at Haydock (1m2f, good to firm) 11 days ago
comments.emilyrebecca: Second over 1m2f in her first two handicaps, before a lesser show in blinkers over 1m4f
comments.grandearmee: No solid form in her qualifying races (1m, AW) but it's easy to think that 1m2f+ will suit
comments.helaali: Modest maiden (eight races) who has not shone in handicaps; upped in trip
comments.hotshotlawyer: Couldn't be any lower for this opening mark and some ability is probably lurking
comments.leadingstargirl: Hasn't really threatened in any of her nine races, in handicaps (7f-1m4f) for the last six
comments.ottoman: 0-10; upped to 1m2f when third at Bath (firm; Respiro Solitario fourth) on latest outing
comments.respirosolitario: In frame in the last four of his five handicaps; hung left when below form at 1m2f latest
comments.shabushabu: Bred far more for this trip and further; off ten weeks (gelded) and cheekpieces go on
comments.splitsilk: Whiff of ability last autumn; beat one home in each of two handicaps (7f/1m2f) this spring

races.raceComment: cudabeenarowlex is marginally preferred with a score of 35.2%, holding clear edges in more proven at trip and better suited by conditions and superior course form over abstractart. Won 1 of last 6 starts. Could develop into tactical affair with no obvious pace-setter. Key attributes include optimal distance, though unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile and regressive form need consideration.

races.drawBiasExplanation: Longer distance reduces impact of draw position

verdict.comment: There is so little of substance to latch on to in this field that PROJECT INCHEON's always-prominent third at Redcar has to stand out.

comments.amberia: 2,000euros yearling by Coulsty; 7th foal; half-sister to four winners; needs a second look
comments.aneedahbeer: 15,000gns breeze-up 2yo; 11th foal; Kodi Bear half-brother to four winners, one useful
comments.beyondthedream: 100-1, slowest into stride and always behind when beaten 18l at Windsor (6f, good to firm)
comments.eyesfront: 66-1, slowly away when 10th of 12 at Windsor (6f, good to firm) but form is as good as any
comments.galileoisland: 10-1, blew the start when eighth of 11 in Newmarket novice (6f, good) 18 days ago
comments.lamnol: 40-1, never close enough or going well enough here (5f, good); now 7f, gelded and hooded
comments.magnatura: 10,000gns foal; eighth foal; half-brother to five winners, three useful
comments.projectincheon: 14-1 third of ten at Redcar (6f, good to firm) 15 days ago, always prominent and rallying
comments.runswick: 15,000gns yearling by Ghaiyyath; first foal; dam 1m winner (RPR 77); needs a close look
comments.tellingtime: 200-1, tailed off at Newbury (6f, good); bred more for this trip; major drop in class
comments.torbay: Got loose before intended debut; 66-1 when last of ten at Windsor (6f, good) 11 days later

races.raceComment: eyesfront is marginally preferred with a score of 17.7%, holding clear edges in better ratings over projectincheon. Going is a significant concern - yet to win on Good To Firm ground from 1 attempts. Could develop into tactical affair with no obvious pace-setter, though step up in class and unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile need consideration.

races.title: Glyn Hall Wealth Management Restricted Maiden Stakes (Band D) (GBB/IRE Incentive Race) (Div II)
races.drawBiasExplanation: Longer distance reduces impact of draw position

verdict.comment: There was more promise than eighth of 12 suggests for JACK THE TOOTH at Windsor. The pick of the many newcomers may be Explosion.

comments.creciente: 6,000gns yearling; yard's sole 2yo winner this term (filly) is 3-3, Listed win last week
comments.eschweiler: 1,000euros yearling by Alkumait; 2yo wins for the stable are rare
comments.explosion: 6,000gns yearling; powerful yard's first 2yo winner this term was a newcomer on Sunday
comments.grandecho: 100-1 for newcomers race at Newbury (5f, good), always towards rear but some ability
comments.jackthetooth: 25-1, about 4l eighth of 12 at Windsor (6f, good to firm) with promise from towards rear
comments.paroleofficer: 11,000gns yearling by Without Parole; early stage for yard's 2yos but worth a market check
comments.penhallam: 16,000gns foal; yard's two 2yo wins last month (from six runs) were both second time out
comments.sovereignlord: 16,000euros yearling; late foal; needs close look; yard has had 2yo newcomer win this year
comments.takeitorleaveit: 8,000gns yearling by Ubettabelieveit; yard without 2yo win at early stage of this season
comments.woodyyfernandez: 8,500gns foal by Lope Y Fernandez; trainer without 2yo win in recent seasons (few runners)

races.raceComment: jackthetooth is marginally preferred with a score of 16.0%. Going is a significant concern - yet to win on Good To Firm ground from 1 attempts. verdict.comment: The style of KORROOR's AW win last time makes 5f look quite tempting. Irish Dancer and War Zone are next on the list.

comments.azucena: 0-11 on turf but beaten about only 2l in handicap latest run; hooded once, now cheekpieces
comments.battleofbaltimore: Some 2024 runs make him of interest, but last month's reappearance less so for new yard
comments.dunningtonlad: Two 5f handicap wins from front at Ripon last summer; 2025 has been a lot less convincing
comments.fregola: Ten-race maiden who does not present convincing claims; first run in a classified race
comments.ifonlytheycudtalk: Win and placed form in 2024; threatened something similar only once (second run) this term
comments.irishdancer: Won on penultimate start; he's one of the most likely to give his running in this field
comments.korroor: Both wins have been on Newcastle AW, 6f in March on latest start; 5f on turf is worth a go
comments.malhamtarncove: Pieces of form last term (one win) to take seriously; may have needed recent reappearance
comments.pastoralway: Eight-race maiden; Carlisle four days ago suggested return to 5f is in order; e-w claims
comments.timebar: 0-13; having tried 1m on last two outings, he now goes shorter than 6f for the first time
comments.warzone: Two 5f Chelmsford wins; has bounced back before; turf debut may ask the biggest question

races.raceComment: malhamtarncove is marginally preferred with a score of 47.5%, holding clear edges in more proven at trip and better suited by conditions over korroor. Placed in 2 of last 6 starts. Likely to be steadily run with pressure on the leader, though unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile need consideration.

verdict.comment: Everything points to ARCHIVIST being hard to beat, as he's got the experience and the best form. Charming Princess is interesting.

comments.archivist: Has an edge in experience over his rivals and also brings the best form
comments.braveguest: Second foal out of a 6f winner (RPR 75), herself a half-sister to two winners
comments.charmingprincess: Wootton Bassett filly who cost 300,000gns as a yearling; intriguing newcomer
comments.cloudshill: Encouraging front-running second on debut but that form has taken some knocks
comments.dinahmyte: Newcomer and others are far more appealing on pedigree
comments.kingofthesea: Nice pedigree but big odds for both his races (on good) and hasn't shown a lot
comments.kuriosgeorge: Keen early and weakened to be beaten 22l at Doncaster; hood retained and now gelded
comments.newyorkminute: Promising debut and then encountered heavy ground; now gelded; retains potential
comments.silentstorm: Got outpaced before rallying into fourth at Newbury (7f, good); should improve
comments.sunshinemag: It was a good race in which he was beaten 9l at Newmarket; has a future
comments.towerlands: Modest form in two races for James Ferguson and moved on for 11,500gns
comments.zouligan: Inexperience very evident when eighth of 11 runners at Newbury (7f, good; 40-1)

races.raceComment: archivist is strongly preferred with a score of 35.0%, holding clear edges in better ratings and more proven at trip and better suited by conditions and stronger recent form and superior course form over cloudshill. Placed in 2 of last 2 starts. Yet to win at leicester in 5 attempts. Key attributes include superior ratings and improving, though returning from absence and step up in class and unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile need consideration.

verdict.comment: The race may be run to suit course-regular CITY ESCAPE in her bid to make it six wins over C&D.

comments.cityescape: Five-time C&D winner; should get the solid pace she needs; likely to go well again
comments.flaine: Consistent since November; weighted to reverse March C&D running with Romantic Spirit
comments.lhebayeb: All five wins have been at Class 6 level so she may find this a bit too competitive
comments.luisa: Nice pedigree and no surprise were she to step forward now switched to a handicap
comments.mysticalqueen: Up in trip for her stable/AW debut after 292 days off and this looks a tough ask
comments.paintthetownred: 0-5; bred to stay this far but does need to improve to get off the mark; cheekpieces on
comments.romanticspirit: Disappointed in her bid for a C&D hat-trick last time, but a player if bouncing back
comments.twobtanned: 4-4 under positive rides on turf since cheekpieces added; return to AW the big question

races.raceComment: flaine is marginally preferred with a score of 51.2%, holding clear edges in more proven at trip and better suited by conditions and stronger recent form and superior course form over cityescape. Won 1 of last 6 starts. Ground (Standard) looks ideal with 3 wins from 13 starts in similar conditions. Key attributes include optimal distance, though returning from absence and step up in class and unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile need consideration.

verdict.comment: Preference is for the consistent PESSOA whose five wins have all come at this track and who was beaten just a nose last time.

comments.aljezur: Plenty of promise in his early starts, but despite a slipping mark is now 0-18

comments.aspiretoglory: Three wins in his last five starts including one over C&D; player again from 2lb higher
comments.haveyouaminute: Seventh of ten on his reappearance over 9.5f here last month; more needed
comments.masterofgreygoose: Showed early promise, but hasn't built on it and now 0-9; needs plenty more
comments.pessoa: Five wins have all come here; seems sure to go well again
comments.riveralwen: Has continued to run well since winning at Chelmsford, but shorter trip may not be ideal
comments.royalobservatory: 3lb higher than when winning over C&D last time; more to recommend him than some

comments.valkyrja: 0-4; drop in trip may help but plenty more will be needed
comments.valueadded: Has shown little since returning for this yard in February; outside stall won't help

verdict.comment: This can go to C&D winner DRAFTED who remains on his last winning mark.

comments.bizarrelaw: Has done well since dropping to 7f, including a win here, but could have been drawn better
comments.boldsuitor: Most consistent on the AW in his last ten starts (1223212423); should go well again
comments.cheesetheone: C&D winner; chased home Bizarre Law on return from another absence here last month
comments.cloudfree: 3lb below sole winning mark, but modest of late and needs a resurgence
comments.drafted: C&D winner who has been placed off this mark here the last twice; high on the list
comments.forevernoah: No improvement in two starts since returning last month and now 0-8; more needed
comments.onceadaay: 8lb below last winning mark and made a promising return, but not built on it; blinkers on
comments.petracelera: Losing run up to 12, but a better effort last time and now 9lb below her last winning mark
comments.starofatlantis: Won easily over 8.6f here last time, but up 7lb and drawn widest
comments.thanksdad: 1-20; fair efforts on turf lately but more needed back on the AW
comments.triggered: 15lb lower than for the latest of two C&D wins, but losing run up to of 20 and drawn wide
comments.whiteumbrella: Has become well handicapped but this trip does appear to stretch her
